notes.message: 728 more trials for Breast cancer mention the drug or condition only in descriptions, often as one of several permitted options. They are listed under mentions but not counted. Set retrieval.name_matching to mentioned to count them.

321 more trials for Prostate cancer mention the drug or condition only in descriptions, often as one of several permitted options. They are listed under mentions but not counted. Set retrieval.name_matching to mentioned to count them.
Breast cancer also includes trials whose MeSH condition is "Carcinoma, Ductal, Breast", "Carcinoma, Lobular" or "Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Syndrome", which sit under it in the MeSH tree.
Because only part of the matching trials could be fetched, each group's count was taken directly from the registry. Citations come from the fetched trials.
